messages:
Priya (PM): Proposal: introduce a 'validation runway' for new catalog entries that need compatibility shims or nonstandard runtime flags. Goal: smaller scope to surface perf/quality/cost issues before full GA. Quick sketch: 48h smoke, 7d micro-canary (5% traffic), 14d graded canary (20%). Agree?
Diego (SRE): +1 on staged ramp. Need explicit hardware pins and autoscale floor so canary traffic doesn't starve other tenants. Also require no >1 infra incident during runway or we pause.
Lina (ML): From bench side: add tokenization parity, semantic drift probe, and eval set A/B against current stable. Numeric gates: p95 <= 150ms, eval AUC >= 0.90, cost multiplier <= 1.15. Lina will own the suite.
Ava (CS): Customers want clear pin expectations. Recommend default pin window 60 days, auto-renew = false, and a documented 'smooth-unpin' ramp (we'll provide 30-day migration checklist).
Ken (Sales): Can we add a one-line legal blurb for AEs: "Enterprise pin available for up to 60 days; longer-term pins require contract amendment." I can draft.
Infra-bot: Validation-runway job template created: job/validation-runway-v1. Canary regions: us-west-2, eu-west-1. Alerts: latency_p95_exceed, error_rate_spike, infra_incident. Dashboard: /dash/runway/validation-runway-v1.
Priya (PM): Nice. Proposed guardrails for admission to full catalog: 1) all bench gates pass, 2) no SRE incidents >1 in runway, 3) migration docs + AE blurb published, 4) ML + SRE + PM signoff. If any owner votes no, hold.
Diego (SRE): Agreed. Also add a 'fence' runtime flag: runtime.compat_fence=true which prevents auto-rollout if set. That way we can keep it isolated until signoff.
Lina (ML): Adding small human spot-check: 10 sampled sessions reviewed for hallucination/semantics. If >2 bad samples, fail. I'll run baseline today and post results.
Ava (CS): Will draft the migration checklist and customer-facing FAQ. Also want per-tenant telemetry so we can track opt-in adoption.
Priya (PM): Draft runway config (wip):
```
runway_name: validation-runway-v1
stages:
  - name: smoke
    duration_days: 2
    traffic_pct: 0
    mode: shadow
  - name: micro_canary
    duration_days: 7
    traffic_pct: 5
  - name: graded_canary
    duration_days: 14
    traffic_pct: 20
hardware_tags: [g5.large, g5.xlarge]
bench_gates:
  latency_p95_ms: 150
  eval_auc_min: 0.90
  cost_multiplier_max: 1.15
pin_policy:
  default_ttl_days: 60
  auto_renew: false
  escape_hatch: rollback-to-stable
owners: [Priya, Diego, Lina, Ava]
```
Ken (Sales): I'll send the AE blurb and flag legal for review. ETA Tues.
Diego (SRE): I'll add autoscale floor, hardware pin enforcement, and the canary suppression rule (pause if infra incident) to the infra job. ETA Fri.
Lina (ML): Running bench now against our sample prompts. Will share a short summary in this thread when done.
Ava (CS): Draft FAQ incoming Monday. We'll include the smooth-unpin ramp steps.
Priya (PM): OK team 1: if runway passes, we'll treat this as the default path for shimmed or compatibility-sensitive models. Action items: Lina run bench, Diego infra changes, Ava docs + telemetry, Ken AE blurb. I'll schedule a 30m decisions call next Wed.
